description: Remove the stray duplicate product from local KV working state so the admin product editor resolves and displays the verified draft (p_322e7n6mth, SKU NGF-SOF-WBJZX0) instead of the auto-generated duplicate (p_eg3vtxpioj, SKU NGF-SOF-9E2HP8). The duplicate exists ONLY in .wrangler/state (git-ignored, local, disposable) and never in the git repository. Because .wrangler/state is a rebuildable cache whose documented recovery path is rehydrate-from-repository, the smallest safe fix is a scripted, local-only KV state repair: delete the stray duplicate draft and rebuild the product index from data/products/*.json. Do NOT edit any tracked source file's identity. Do NOT create any product. Do NOT publish.
steps: Read src/lib/github/drafts.ts (resolveProduct, getDraft, putDraft, deleteDraft, rehydrateFromRepository) and src/lib/products/index-store.ts (readProductIndex, writeProductIndex, summarize, rememberProduct, forgetProduct, PRODUCT_INDEX_KEY) to understand the exact KV key shape: drafts are stored under `draft:<productId>` and the index under `index:products`.

Confirm the problem state in local KV: the DRAFTS namespace dir is .wrangler/state/v3/kv/REPLACE_WITH_DRAFTS_KV_NAMESPACE_ID/. The stray duplicate is id p_eg3vtxpioj (slug premium-3-1-1-sofa-set, sku NGF-SOF-9E2HP8, status REVIEW); the verified product is id p_322e7n6mth (slug brown-sofa, sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0). Confirm there is NO data/products/premium-3-1-1-sofa-set.json (there must not be one after this fix either).

Write a small local-only, one-off repair script at scripts/repair-sofa-kv.ts (tsx) that operates on the local wrangler KV via `wrangler kv` --local commands OR a documented manual sequence. It must, against the DRAFTS KV namespace, --local ONLY: (a) delete the stray draft key `draft:p_eg3vtxpioj`, and (b) rebuild `index:products` so it contains exactly the products that have a committed file under data/products/ (i.e. p_322e7n6mth/brown-sofa and p_qrmfww7uiz/corner-sofa), dropping the p_eg3vtxpioj entry. Reuse the existing summarize()/ProductSchema logic from the codebase rather than hand-rolling the summary shape. Never pass --remote. If wrangler CLI KV access proves impractical in this environment, instead directly and safely remove the stray entries from the local sqlite/blob state under .wrangler/state/v3/kv/REPLACE_WITH_DRAFTS_KV_NAMESPACE_ID/, or as a last resort delete the entire local KV dir (.wrangler/state/v3/kv) which is git-ignored and rebuilt on next `npm run e2e:prepare`/rehydrate; document whichever approach is used in the feature findings.

Prefer the most surgical option that leaves the verified draft (draft:p_322e7n6mth) and the corner-sofa draft intact. Only fall back to wiping the whole local KV dir if targeted removal is not feasible; note the tradeoff (drafts would need a rehydrate to be repopulated) in findings.
Do NOT delete or modify data/products/brown-sofa.json, data/products/corner-sofa.json, or any tracked file. Do NOT change product identity anywhere.
Verify the committed record is still exactly correct after the repair (id p_322e7n6mth, sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0, name 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set', price 41990, status DRAFT).
acceptance_criteria: The stray duplicate id p_eg3vtxpioj / sku NGF-SOF-9E2HP8 no longer exists in local KV state (neither as a draft:<id> key nor in the index:products entry).

The verified product p_322e7n6mth with sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0 (slug brown-sofa) is the record present in KV state for the 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set' identity, and its committed file data/products/brown-sofa.json is unchanged.
No committed product file for premium-3-1-1-sofa-set exists; no product was created or published.
`npx vitest run tests/unit/real-content-sofas.test.ts` still passes and `npm run check` (typecheck) succeeds if a new script was added.
git status shows no changes to data/products/*.json (only, at most, the new git-ignored/scratch repair script or nothing tracked at all).
findings:
FIX COMPLETE. Root cause confirmed exactly as diagnosed: a stray duplicate existed ONLY in local git-ignored KV state (.wrangler/state/v3/kv/REPLACE_WITH_DRAFTS_KV_NAMESPACE_ID). The DRAFTS namespace id in wrangler.toml is literally 'REPLACE_WITH_DRAFTS_KV_NAMESPACE_ID', which matches the local state dir, so `wrangler kv ... --binding DRAFTS --local` operates on exactly this state.

PRE-STATE (confirmed via `wrangler kv key list --binding DRAFTS --local` and reading the four blobs): keys were draft:p_322e7n6mth (verified, sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0), draft:p_eg3vtxpioj (STRAY duplicate, sku NGF-SOF-9E2HP8, slug premium-3-1-1-sofa-set, status REVIEW, 4 images, NO repo file), draft:p_qrmfww7uiz (Corner Sofa), and index:products which mapped ONLY p_eg3vtxpioj — so the admin resolver shadowed the verified product with the stray one, showing the auto-generated SKU.

APPROACH (most surgical option from the plan; did NOT wipe the KV dir): added a local-only, one-off repair script scripts/repair-sofa-kv.ts (tsx). It (a) rebuilds index:products from the committed data/products/*.json files using the codebase's own ProductSchema + summarize() (repository-authoritative, same principle as rehydrateFromRepository), yielding exactly {p_322e7n6mth: brown-sofa/NGF-SOF-WBJZX0, p_qrmfww7uiz: corner-sofa/NGF-SOF-YAM8K3}, and (b) deletes the stray draft:p_eg3vtxpioj key (which a plain rehydrate would NOT remove, since it has no repo file). Both writes go through `wrangler kv key put/delete --binding DRAFTS --local`. The script hard-refuses any --remote arg. It writes the index JSON via a git-ignored .wrangler/tmp scratch file (mode 0600) that it deletes in a finally block. The verified draft (draft:p_322e7n6mth) and the corner-sofa draft (draft:p_qrmfww7uiz) were left untouched.

Run output: `repair-sofa-kv — rebuilt index from 2 committed product file(s): p_322e7n6mth, p_qrmfww7uiz` / wrote index:products (local) / deleted draft:p_eg3vtxpioj (local).

POST-STATE VERIFICATION:
- `wrangler kv key list --binding DRAFTS --local` => draft:p_322e7n6mth, draft:p_qrmfww7uiz, index:products. The stray draft:p_eg3vtxpioj is GONE.
- `wrangler kv key get index:products --binding DRAFTS --local --text` maps only p_322e7n6mth (slug brown-sofa, sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0, name 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set', price 41990, status DRAFT) and p_qrmfww7uiz (corner-sofa). No p_eg3vtxpioj / NGF-SOF-9E2HP8 anywhere.
- draft:p_322e7n6mth still holds sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0 and id p_322e7n6mth unchanged; the stray sku NGF-SOF-9E2HP8 does not appear in it.
- data/products/brown-sofa.json and data/products/corner-sofa.json unchanged (`git diff --stat` empty). No data/products/premium-3-1-1-sofa-set.json exists. No product created, none published.

TEST/VERIFICATION RESULTS:
- `npx vitest run tests/unit/real-content-sofas.test.ts` => 17/17 PASS (pins sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0, name 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set', slug brown-sofa, price 41990, WhatsApp enquiry '(SKU: NGF-SOF-WBJZX0)').
- `npm run check` (astro check && tsc --noEmit) => 0 errors, 0 warnings, 21 hints (378 files). The new scripts/repair-sofa-kv.ts typechecks clean; the hints are pre-existing Zod .datetime()/.passthrough() deprecation notices in src/schemas/* unrelated to this change.
- `npm test` (vitest run) => 969 passed, 5 failed across 4 files — IDENTICAL in count and nature to the FEAT-001 baseline (analytics.snapshot Worker-entry, security.build-output x2, seo.meta, supporting-pages-showroom). All are build-artifact/SEO/showroom, none reference the SKU/sofa/KV resolver/data/products. One additional flaky timing-sensitive test (auth.session.integration.test.ts 'per-email lockout escalation') occasionally trips under full-suite parallel load but PASSES 19/19 when run in isolation; it exercises rate-limiter escalation windows and is unrelated to the DRAFTS KV change (which does not touch auth/sessions/D1).

CONSTRAINTS HONORED: no commit, no push, no --remote wrangler, no wipe of the KV dir, no modification of any tracked source file (git status shows only untracked .agents/ and the new scripts/repair-sofa-kv.ts). Product id p_322e7n6mth and sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0 preserved exactly. No scratch files left behind.
